about_the_game:
Crazy TaiJi is a casual card game inspired by traditional Chinese culture

In the game, you will use 64 sword-shaped cards to form combinations and activate spells, earning points to defeat monsters.

With resources gained from battles, you can improve your abilities and break through to higher realms of cultivation.

​Card System​

The deck consists of ​64 cards, each corresponding to one of the ​64 Hexagrams from the I Ching (Book of Changes)​​

Cards are divided into four types, representing the ​Four Symbols in Taichi philosophy:

​Azure Dragon (青龙)​​

​White Tiger (白虎)​​

​Vermilion Bird (朱雀)​​

​Black Tortoise (玄武)​​

Spell Mechanics​

Spells are activated by specific card combinations:

​Pair combo​(D): Two or more cards with the same number.

​Stacked Strike (T)​: Three or more cards of the same type (e.g., all Azure Dragon).

​Wave Strike (S)​: Three or more cards with consecutive numbers.

Combining the above patterns creates more powerful spells.

Enhancement Systems​

​Sigil System (秘符)​: Enhances card effects during battles.

​Taichi Tome (太极秘籍)​: Boosts attack power and unlocks advanced strategies.

Progression & Levels​

The game features three major tiers:

​Primordial (Yuan)​​

​Spirit (Ling)​​

​Immortal (Xian)​

Each tier includes ​20 stages, with each stage comprising six battles: 3 general monsters,2 small boss,1 big boss

Victory rewards resources to upgrade cards and spells

Game Modes​

​Cycle of Reincarnation​: Based on the ​Six Realms of Rebirth​ (Heaven, Human, Asura, Animal, Hungry Ghost, Hell)

​Endless Mode​: Focused on immortal cultivation level.

​Wuji Realm (​Domain of Infinity)​: Unlocked after completing 20 rounds across both modes

The content in this game is inspired by elements related to Taoist Tai Chi theory, such as Wuji, Tai Chi, Liangyi, Sixiang, Bagua, Yin-Yang, etc
